title: RIFTBREAK
tagline: A shedding-card party game where the rules of reality keep changing and a shared Meltdown meter threatens to collapse the table.

roles.name: Player
roles.description: Quick Play against bots offline, or create a room and share the 4-letter code. Bots fill empty seats.

multiplayer.style: competitive card game, server-authoritative, room code
multiplayer.notes: Online rooms run on the game's own WebSocket server (server/index.mjs, loaded by npm start): shuffles, draws, legality and turns are decided there and each player only receives their own hand. Solo play against Easy/Normal/Hard bots works offline. Rules: games/riftbreak/docs/RULES.md.
